title: Stop TrackLearningOrderRepositoryImpl importing ContentRepository directly — compose in a service/notifier (SM-8)
why: TrackLearningOrderRepositoryImpl takes a ContentRepository constructor dependency and calls `_contentRepository.getContentForCurriculum(...)` directly from three of its own methods (_buildSedarimIndex, _buildMasechtosIndex). This is exactly the repository-imports-repository shape SM-8 forbids: unit-testing this repository now requires faking or booting ContentRepository's dependency chain instead of a clean seam, and the file's own doc comments on MasechtaOrderingPolicy already flag this as a known-wrong coupling ('Unblocks W4.22 (_buildMasechtosIndex removal from the repository impl)') that the team is mid-way through unwinding.
recommendation: Move the content-fetch + index-build orchestration into a domain service or the notifier that currently constructs TrackLearningOrderRepositoryImpl, passing the already-resolved content list/indices into the repository (or into MasechtaOrderingPolicy directly), so the repository itself only talks to its own DAO.
acceptance_criteria: TrackLearningOrderRepositoryImpl no longer imports anything under features/content_browsing/.
A unit test constructs TrackLearningOrderRepositoryImpl with only a fake/in-memory database (no ContentRepository fake required).
SM-8's grep/lint (once implemented) reports zero repository→repository imports in lib/features/tracks/.
